w10_P4_000451: The figure a lab wants, in J, is the grand total of 10 identical racks, each rack being 3 identical trolleys, each trolley's figure being its energy of motion plus 7 J held in its bumper spring. Each trolley has a mass of 36 kg and a length of 0.9 m. The trolleys' speed in m/s is set equal to the speed at t = 1 s of a reference cart whose position in metres is s(t) = 2t^3 - 1t^2 with t in seconds. What grand total, in J, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000455: The figure a parcel depot wants, in J, is the net energy of a shift: the gross energy of 2 identical lines, minus 11 J lost to belt friction. Each line's gross energy is 12 identical totes, each tote's figure being its energy of motion plus 14 J stored in its latch spring. Each tote has a mass of 19000 grams. The totes' speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. What net shift energy, in J, does the depot record?
w10_P4_000464: A luggage tug pulls carts of mass 65 kg across an apron 45 m wide. Each cart's acceleration in m/s^2 is 11 more than the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 7 = 0. The tug pulls 8 identical carts, each with the force producing that acceleration. Express the tug's total pull in kN.
w10_P4_000466: The number a marina wants, in kJ, is the combined energy of motion of the tenders on 2 identical docks, each dock holding 4 identical tenders, each tender's energy of motion expressed in kJ. Each tender has a mass of 49000 grams. The tenders' speed in m/s is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 13x + 42 = 0. What combined energy, in kJ, does the marina record?
w10_P4_000467: The figure a rig operator wants, in kN, is the combined mount load of 3 identical rigs, each rig's mount load expressed in kN. A rig's mount load is the drive force on its sled, minus 4 kN supplied by a booster spring, plus 14 kN of static preload. Each sled has a mass of 82000 grams, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 5t^3 + 0t^2. The drive force is the force producing the sled's acceleration at t = 2 s. What combined mount load, in kN, does the operator report?
w10_P4_000468: A container-yard shuttle of mass 150 kg and length 3.5 m is accelerated along a rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 11 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. A rail drives 11 identical shuttles, each with the force producing that acceleration, and a tensioner relieves 9 N of each rail's combined push. The yard has 8 identical rails. What total push, in N, do the 8 rails deliver?
w10_P4_000469: The number a foundry wants, in N, is the grand total over 12 identical shifts, each shift's total being the frame load of a casting line. The frame load is the combined push of 12 identical stations, each station driving 4 identical moulds, plus 18 N from a guide spring. Each mould has a mass of 178000 grams and is pushed with the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the sum of the squares of the whole numbers from 1 to 4. What grand total, in N, does the foundry report?
w10_P4_000474: The figure a rail-yard engineer wants, in N, is the coupling load on a test wagon: the force producing the wagon's acceleration plus 2 N of coupling friction. The wagon has a mass of 182 kg and runs on a level siding. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is found by counting the ways of choosing 3 of the yard's 8 sidings, subtracting 12, and then subtracting 22. What coupling load, in N, does the engineer record?
w10_P4_000476: The figure a courier network wants, in J, is the grand total energy of motion across 10 identical regions, each region having 7 identical depots, each depot running 10 identical routes, each route using 7 identical vans, every van carrying the same energy of motion. Each van is a scale test model of mass 20 kg and length 0.8 m. The vans' speed in m/s equals the speed at t = 2 s of a pace vehicle whose position in metres is s(t) = 2t^3 + 2t^2 with t in seconds. What grand total, in J, does the network report?
w10_P4_000485: A baggage sled of mass 47000 grams is accelerated along a level ramp 14 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 5 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 12x + 32 = 0, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. There are 7 identical sleds driven at once. What total force, in kN, is applied to the 7 sleds?
w10_P4_000487: The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is the total energy on a test bench: the combined energy of motion of 8 identical trolleys, plus 17 J from a heater coil, plus 22 J from a charging capacitor. Each trolley has a mass of 18000 grams. The trolleys' speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 88 and 163 exactly. What total energy, in kJ, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000492: A car-plant conveyor accelerates body shells of mass 105000 grams along a line. Each shell's acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 256 and 159 exactly, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. A line carries 10 identical shells, a hall has 2 identical lines, and the plant has 6 identical halls. What total force, in kN, is applied to all the shells?
w10_P4_000499: The figure a test lab wants, in J, is the session total: 28 J held in the launcher spring plus the combined figure for 6 identical runs. Each run's figure is the sled's energy of motion, plus 17 J from its brake spring, minus 8 J lost to rail friction. The sled has a mass of 59000 grams. Its speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 1 s of a pace cart whose position in metres is s(t) = 5t^3 - 2t^2 with t in seconds. What session total, in J, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000503: A rescue drone of mass 56000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to 9 times the sum of 3 and 5. A patrol is 7 identical drones flying at that speed, and the ground station adds 3 J for the energy in its telemetry capacitor to the patrol's combined energy of motion. Express the resulting patrol total in kJ.
w10_P4_000504: The value a dock supervisor wants, in N, is the net winch-frame load: the combined load of 11 identical winches, plus 22 N from the frame's tensioning spring, minus 15 N of relief from a counterweight. Each winch's load is the force producing its sled's acceleration plus 25 N of cable friction. Each sled has a mass of 106 kg and runs on a level slipway. The sleds' acceleration in m/s^2 is the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 4. What net frame load, in N, does the supervisor record?
w10_P4_000509: A robotic pallet mover of mass 36000 grams runs on a warehouse rail 28 m long, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 3t^3 + 3t^2. The force producing its acceleration at t = 2 s is expressed in kN. A bay drives 5 identical movers, and each bay's frame also carries 2 kN of static load on top of the combined drive. The warehouse has 12 identical bays. What total load, in kN, do the 12 bay frames carry?
w10_P4_000512: A supermarket trolley of mass 83000 grams is pushed along an aisle 30 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 10x + 16 = 0. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a ramp, which contributes 13 N, and partly by a tailwind fan, which contributes 28 N; the pusher supplies the rest. A team pushes 6 identical trolleys in this way, and the store runs 6 identical teams. What total push, in N, do the pushers supply?
w10_P4_000513: A lab cart of mass 15 kg rides a rail 2 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 0 and x = 1. The cart's drive must supply the force producing that acceleration plus 10 N of bearing friction. Two identical carts are driven at once, and their combined drive force is expressed in kN. The load cell reading is that combined value minus a 1 kN zero offset (the reading may be negative). What does the load cell read, in kN?
w10_P4_000514: The figure a conveyor installer wants, in kN, is the net cable load: the combined load of 11 identical hoists minus 20 N of relief from a balance spring. Each hoist's load is the force producing its carriage's acceleration plus 20 N of guide friction. Each carriage has a mass of 108 kg and runs on a level rail 30 m long. The carriages' acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 216 and 181 exactly. What net cable load, in kN, does the installer record?
w10_P4_000515: A pneumatic sorter flicks parcels of mass 25000 grams along a chute. Each parcel's acceleration in m/s^2 is the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 10. The sorter flicks 11 identical parcels at once, each with the force producing that acceleration, and the combined force is expressed in kN. A counter-spring relieves 5 kN of that combined force from the sorter's frame. What net force, in kN, does the frame carry?
w10_P4_000517: The number a drone-range manager wants, in kJ, is the daily total: 12 identical sessions, each session's figure being the combined energy of motion of 3 identical drones, expressed in kJ, minus 3 kJ consumed by the launch catapult. Each drone has a mass of 8 kg. The drones' speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 1 s of a chase car whose position in metres is s(t) = 5t^3 + 6t^2 with t in seconds. What daily total, in kJ, does the manager record?
w10_P4_000518: The figure a lab wants, in J, is the total for 10 identical trolleys, each trolley's figure being its energy of motion, plus 15 J from its heater, plus 10 J from its charging coil. Each trolley has a mass of 48000 grams. The trolleys' speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 0x between x = 0 and x = 1. What total, in J, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000523: A bakery conveyor carries trays of mass 52000 grams at a speed in m/s equal to 2 times the sum of 2 and 1. A rack holds 12 identical trays; the combined energy of motion of a rack plus 19 J stored in its latch spring is the rack's energy figure, expressed in kJ. The bakery runs 12 identical racks. What is the total energy figure, in kJ, for all 12 racks?
w10_P4_000525: A ski-resort test sled of mass 15000 grams runs down a slope 200 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 2x between x = 3 and x = 4. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 20 kJ of stored winch energy is added to give one run's figure. A pair of identical runs has 2 times that figure, from which 7 kJ absorbed by the run-out mats is subtracted. What net figure, in kJ, does the resort record for the pair?
w10_P4_000534: A robotics lab has 7 charging docks and counts the ways of choosing 2 of them for a test pair; that count is used as the speed in m/s of a 25000 gram robot on a track 10 m long. A squad of 12 identical robots has a combined energy of motion, which the lab expresses in kJ. The lab adds 16 kJ for the squad's spare batteries and then subtracts 24 kJ consumed by the charging docks. What figure, in kJ, does the lab record?
